# phb Paper Honeycomb Board

> phb is a Malaysian supplier of industrial-grade paper honeycomb board — a structural packaging material that is ISPM-15 exempt (no fumigation required), 70% lighter than plywood, and 100% curbside recyclable. Headquartered in Johor Bahru with a KL logistics hub, phb serves manufacturers, logistics operators, and creative studios across Malaysia and Singapore.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.paperhoneycombboard.com/): Overview of phb paper honeycomb board — key benefits, weight savings calculator, industry verticals, and FAQ.
- [Combat Zone – Material Comparison](https://www.paperhoneycombboard.com/combat-zone/): Head-to-head comparison of phb paper vs plywood vs plastic on weight, ISPM-15 compliance, recyclability, and total cost savings.
- [The Eco-Lab – Creative & Architectural Use](https://www.paperhoneycombboard.com/eco-lab/): Architectural panels, prototyping, sculptural furniture, and modular installations using honeycomb structural panels.
- [Regional Solutions – Malaysia & Singapore Exports](https://www.paperhoneycombboard.com/regional/): ISPM-15 exempt pallet solutions for Klang Valley, Johor Bahru, and Singapore export corridors. JIT delivery to Shah Alam, Petaling Jaya, and Port Klang.
- [Contact – Get a Hex-Sample Kit](https://www.paperhoneycombboard.com/contact/): Request an architect-grade sample kit or get a quote from the engineering team.

## Key Product Facts

- Standard pallet weight: 5 kg (vs 25 kg plywood, 18 kg plastic)
- ISPM-15 status: Exempt by material property — no fumigation, no heat treatment, no border delays
- Recyclability: 100% curbside recyclable Kraft paper construction
- Compression force: 12 kN
- Weight reduction vs plywood: 80%
- Air freight savings: ~$90 per pallet at $4.50/kg average rate; $45,000 on a 500-pallet shipment
- Total cost reduction vs plywood: up to 70%
- Trusted by: PALLITE, Tetra Pak, DB Schenker

## Service Area

- Kuala Lumpur logistics hub (local stock, JIT delivery)
- Delivery to: Shah Alam, Petaling Jaya, Klang Valley, Johor Bahru
- Port access: Port Klang North & West Ports (daily routes)
- Singapore export corridor

## Industry Verticals

- **Electronics**: Anti-static, shock-absorbent packaging for components and microchips
- **Logistics**: Load-bearing pallets and void fillers for high-density global shipping
- **Creative / Architecture**: Lightweight structural panels for displays, temporary furniture, pop-up events, and art installations
